lines: Bakul Hiralal Shah, an Investor Selling Shareholder, sells up to 12,600 shares in the offer for sale, with proceeds up to ₹1.70 crore if all offered shares are sold.
The sale is estimated to bring a gain of up to ₹1.26 crore before offer expenses and taxes; the employee-portion discount means actual proceeds are slightly lower.
The money has been in hand since listing (trading started March 11, 2026), so the call is timely to discuss what they plan to do with it.
Family link: Atul Hiralal Shah shares the surname Shah and middle name Hiralal. Retained holding is an estimate of ₹3.97 crore at offer price; confidence is medium.
